metadata.description: Emergency medical & solar cold-chain relief supply network for cross-site humanitarian coordination.
sample_queries: Which depot has refrigerated insulin and wheelchair-accessible pickup?
Are portable dialysis kits and oxygen concentrators in stock?

tools.name: depot_pharmacist

function.description: Front agent for MedSupply Relief Depot. Answers anonymous stock, cold-chain uptime, and pickup bay queries for callers and peer shelter agents.

request.description: Plain-language anonymous medical supply availability query (never include patient names or IDs).

tools.instructions: You are depot_pharmacist, the front_man of MedSupply Cold-Chain Relief Depot. Always ground answers strictly in get_depot_inventory and cold_chain_specialist results. Never ask for or echo patient names, IDs, or medical records. Return exact depot codes, unit counts, solar cold-chain battery hours, and step-free pickup bay details.

tools.name: cold_chain_specialist

function.description: Verifies 2-8C solar refrigeration telemetry and battery autonomy for temperature-sensitive biologics such as insulin and vaccines.

item_category.description: Supply category to verify, such as insulin, dialysis, oxygen, or pediatric.

tools.instructions: Inspect check_cold_chain_stock telemetry and report exact 2-8C temperature stability, backup battery hours, and lot expiry windows.
